snippet.title: Nier Gestalt v1.22 - 1.0 Mod Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://www.nexusmods.com/nierreplicant/mods/111

Thumbnail artwork created by JackBoU (@JackboyArt)

After 4 months or so in development, the full version of the Nier Gestalt v1.22 mod, which now includes text and voice replacements, is finally here.
Please let me know what you think if you try it!

Note: This mod only supports English text and voices. While Gestalt never had Japanese voice acting, please get in contact with me if you want to create support for a different text language and need my help with editing the text files.

Nier Replicant ver.1.22474487139... is property of S.E. & Toylogic. This project is fan-made and will always be available for free on the nexusmods page. If you paid for this mod, you have been scammed. This project requires you to own Nier Replicant ver.1.22... on Steam, and support will not be provided for those using illegally obtained copies.
